title: Guest
notFound: This guest does not exist or was deleted.

status.title: Status
status.enabledDescription: Disabled guests cannot authenticate at terminals, even with a valid code.

enrollment.title: Terminal enrollment
enrollment.description: Share the QR code or the setup key with the guest so they can add it to their authenticator app. At the terminal they enter their guest code plus the current one-time code.
enrollment.qrHint: Scan with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, …)
enrollment.noCredential: This guest has no active credential. Provision one to allow terminal login.

success.rotated: Credential rotated. Share the new QR code with the guest.
success.revoked: Credential revoked. The guest can no longer authenticate.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke credential?
confirmRevoke.description: The guest will no longer be able to authenticate at terminals until a new credential is provisioned.

access.title: Resource access
access.description: Guests get access through introductions. They can never become introducers or maintainers.
access.loadError: Failed to load the guest's access. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete guest
delete.description: This permanently removes the guest account. This action cannot be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: The guest account and its credential will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
